title: While the agent runs and the person has typed a draft, a Stop button stays beside Queue Send
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node tests/regression/scripts/REG-PR-1049-stop-beside-send.mjs (the fork needs its own install: CI=true corepack pnpm install --ignore-scripts --frozen-lockfile inside vendor/tracy/deepseek-harness).
S2: Record the exit code and every line starting 'ok -' or 'not ok -'.

S3 (stand, tasks/bang-chung/lan-7-nut-stop-khi-dang-go/): dsh with fork tracy.26 + tracy-web + real model. On a site, send a long request, and while the agent runs type a new message without sending it. Read the buttons of the chat box, press Stop, read the box and the network.
expect: S1 exits 0 with 'ALL CHECKS PASSED': InputBar carries `interruptible = running && (continuable || (subagent === null && !primaryStops))`, and the two fork cases 'Tracy: a running ordinary session keeps a Stop button beside Queue Send while a draft is typed' and 'Tracy: an idle session never draws Stop, with or without a draft' pass.

S3: with a draft typed the chat box shows Add files, Stop generating, Queue message (before: Add files, Queue message only); pressing Stop ends the run with the label Stopped, keeps the typed text, and the only session call is cancel; with an empty box there is exactly one Stop.
evidence: A customer, 08/10/2026: sent a wrong prompt and could not stop the running process. Measured: Stop works with an empty box (button 107 ms after Enter, run stops in 0.5 s) but disappears as soon as the next message is being typed. Evidence: tasks/bang-chung/lan-7-nut-stop-khi-dang-go/KET-QUA.md.
fence: Only whether an independent Stop is drawn changes; what Stop does (session/cancel, queue preserved) is dsh's own and untouched.
